seo.homeDescription: Interactive Grain & Grains (Grain and Grains) coffee flavor wheel. Explore the full SCA taxonomy for specialty coffee tasting — fruity, floral, roasted, sweet and more.
seo.peruTitle: Peruvian Coffee Flavor Wheel | Grain & Grains
seo.peruDescription: Grain & Grains Peruvian coffee flavor wheel: Amazonian and Andean fruits, chilies, native chuncho and porcelana cacao, lucuma and Peru's unique flavors.

describe.fragranceBoth: On the fragrance, the sample opens with an aromatic expression of {aromatic}, interwoven with fruity notes of {fruity}.
describe.fragranceAromatic: On the fragrance, a floral note of {aromatic} dominates, perfuming the first contact with the cup.
describe.fragranceFruity: On the fragrance, the sample shows fruity notes of {fruity} with good intensity.
describe.palateStart: In the cup, the flavor profile unfolds with {items}.
describe.palateSweetRoasty: On the palate, the sweetness of {sweet} converses with a roasted base of {roasty}.
describe.palateSweetRoastySpice: On the palate, the sweetness of {sweet} converses with a roasted base of {roasty}, with spiced hints of {spice}.
describe.palateSweet: In the mouth, a medium body rests on a base of {sweet}.
describe.palateSweetSpice: In the mouth, a medium body rests on a base of {sweet} and spices of {spice}.
describe.palateRoasty: In the cup, the roasted profile of {roasty} dominates the palate.
describe.palateRoastySpice: In the cup, the roasted profile of {roasty} dominates the palate, accompanied by {spice}.

describe.finishMid: The finish leaves a pleasant, well-defined sensation on the palate.

describe.defectMany: Defects of {defects} are recorded, reducing the cleanliness score and impacting the overall experience.

describe.sca85: Estimated SCA score: {score} — high-quality specialty coffee, with attributes exceeding the minimum protocol standards.
describe.sca80: Estimated SCA score: {score} — qualifies as specialty under the SCA protocol, with satisfactory balance and uniformity.
describe.sca75: Estimated SCA score: {score} — below the specialty threshold (80 pts), with identifiable potential that needs work in processing.
